key_insight: The paper shows that agentic AI can help build a machine-checked Lean formalization of Shor-style quantum attacks, including resource estimates for breaking RSA-2048 and P-256.
engineering_relevance: This work provides a reproducible formal foundation for quantum cryptanalysis, helping researchers verify algorithm logic, circuit constructions, and attack costs in cryptographic settings.
method: Agents search sources, write Lean code, and repair proofs under human review.
Formalize Shor-family mathematics from order finding to reversible modular and elliptic-curve arithmetic.
Derive logical resource estimates for RSA-2048 and P-256, plus added classical-operation estimates.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports machine-checked Lean proofs and resource estimates grounded in prior results for RSA-2048 and P-256 from Quantum 5 and ASIACRYPT 2017.
watch_item: The scientific claims still require human review, and the formalization depends on the quality and scope of the underlying source material and proof repair process.
paper_title: Building Shor's Algorithm in Lean: An Agentic Formalization of Quantum Attacks on RSA-2048 and P-256
